correctness.rationale: For normalized weighted Bergman monomials, all big-Hankel images have pairwise orthogonal angular frequencies and exact positive square d_n^2=E[U_nY_n^2]-n/(n+alpha+1)(EY_n)^2. It differs from Var(Y_n) by O_alpha(1/n). Rescaled beta variables converge to Gamma(alpha+1,1), with uniform logarithmic fourth moments and controlled polynomial/exponential endpoint tails; centered Taylor expansion of (1+log(n/X_n))^-a gives exact a² psi1(alpha+1)/(log n)^(2a+2). Asymptotic monotone comparison controls decreasing rearrangement and counting. Checker has 241 finite corroborative assertions, none substituted for infinite analysis. Limitations: fixed alpha,a; no separate validation.

value.rationale: A concrete continuous-to-the-closed-disk perturbation of H_bar z changes singular values from an inverse-linear scale to an arbitrary inverse-log exponent, while retaining compactness but excluding every finite Schatten ideal. Exact trigamma constant, full singular-number limit and counting function quantify a meaningful sharp stability/regularity boundary absent from the motivating qualitative criteria; not merely a formal substitution or numerical table.
